equipment.name: Centrifugal Pump Assembly
equipment.description: Heavy-duty industrial centrifugal water pump driven by a three-phase induction motor and flexible shaft coupling.

components.name: Electric Motor
components.description: 45kW 3-phase induction motor driving the primary pump drive shaft.
components.inspectionTips: Check terminal box, cooling fins, and verify grounding connection.
components.safetyNotes: Ensure power disconnect is locked out before tactile inspection.

components.name: Shaft Coupling
components.description: Flexible elastomeric jaw coupling transmitting torque from motor to impeller shaft.
components.inspectionTips: Inspect elastomeric insert for degradation, cracking, or angular misalignment.
components.safetyNotes: Coupling guard must be reinstalled prior to operational testing.

components.name: Pump Casing & Impeller Assembly
components.description: Cast iron volute casing with mechanical seal chamber and suction/discharge flanges.
components.inspectionTips: Check mechanical seal for fluid weeping and verify flange bolt torques.
components.safetyNotes: Depressurize and vent suction lines before inspecting seal gland.

procedures.name: Centrifugal Pump Preventive Inspection
procedures.description: Standard step-by-step pre-service mechanical and electrical integrity assessment.

steps.title: Electric Motor Inspection
steps.instruction: Inspect the electric motor housing for surface contamination, overheating signs, and verify power feed cables are undamaged.
steps.warning: Confirm high-voltage lockout/tagout (LOTO) isolation before approaching motor terminals.

steps.title: Shaft Coupling Alignment
steps.instruction: Inspect the shaft coupling and flexible element for signs of wear, eccentric play, or elastomer shearing.
steps.warning: Ensure shaft has completely stopped spinning before inspecting coupling gap.

steps.title: Pump Casing & Valves Verification
steps.instruction: Verify that suction and discharge valves are in their correct positions, check for casing leakage, and inspect mechanical seal.
steps.warning: Check line pressure gauges to ensure volute casing is not overpressurized.
